## Summary
Describe the concrete change and why it is needed.

## Scope
- [ ] The PR contains only related changes.
- [ ] No secret, token, password, private key, keystore, recovery code, or production credential is included.
- [ ] Security/privacy impact has been considered.

## Verification
List exact commands, workflow runs, artifacts, hashes, screenshots, or runtime evidence used to verify the change.

- [ ] Relevant tests/builds passed, or blockers are documented.
- [ ] Dependency and supply-chain changes were reviewed.
- [ ] CI/CD or permission changes use least privilege.
- [ ] Generated release artifacts have immutable hash evidence when applicable.
- [ ] Untested behavior is not reported as PASS.

## Risk and rollback
Describe failure modes and the rollback path.

## Related work
Link issues, incidents, discussions, or dependent PRs.
